name: Monitor Process Water
implementation_notes: process_water_record/process_water_detail local SQLite tables added to localSchema.ts (CREATE_PROCESS_WATER_RECORD/CREATE_PROCESS_WATER_DETAIL, appended to CREATE_TABLE_STATEMENTS) -- mirrors threshing_record/threshing_detail's shape exactly, following the hourly-grid (dynamic add-row/remove-row) pattern

processWaterRecordRepo.ts covers all 3 mobile Process Water screens (062/072/082) in one file, same convention as threshingRecordRepo.ts covering screens 037/041/045; its full unit test coverage (processWaterRecordRepo.spec.ts, 29 tests) is reported under this screen since it was authored first in sequence
createDraft() inserts ONLY the header row -- process_water_detail rows are added one at a time by the user in Form Process Water via 'Tambah baris', exactly mirroring threshingRecordRepo.ts's pattern
'Jumlah Baris Time-Slot Tercatat' counter is a plain COUNT(*) of process_water_detail rows belonging to today's records -- no filled-row filter, mirrors Threshing's Monitor counter exactly

Router: route name 'monitor-process-water' registered in router/index.ts -- StationListView.vue (screen-006) already had this route name pre-wired in MONITOR_ROUTE_NAMES and a 'process-water': false placeholder in draftStatusByType; this implementation wires the real processWaterRecordRepo.getDrafts() call into StationListView.vue's Promise.all, replacing that placeholder with processWater.length > 0 -- UNLIKE Threshing (which left screen-006 wiring as a known_issue), this small, additive change to the pre-existing scaffolding was completed as part of this task since the hook points already existed
This station has NO operational-target reference table -- no seeder/model/constant of any kind, unlike Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant

REVISI (2026-10-03, run penuh Playwright mobile 430 lulus / 0 gagal): mobile/tests/e2e/monitor-process-water.spec.ts 8/8 lulus — kini dijalankan nyata, bukan hanya review statis (known_issue 'tidak dapat dijalankan di sandbox' dihapus). Perbaikan spec (drift, bukan cacat aplikasi): cek negatif not.toHaveURL memakai glob '**/…' yang digabung ke baseURL sehingga tak pernah cocok — kini RegExp.

deferred_items.description: syncService.ts's syncAllRecords() was NOT extended with a syncProcessWaterRecords() function (unlike Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant, which each have one calling POST /api/process-water-records via the mobile 'Sinkronisasi' button)
deferred_items.reason: Out of this 6-screen task's explicit scope; the most recent precedent station (Solid Waste Disposal) made the same deferral decision for the same reason. The web POST/PATCH routes are already dual-guarded ('auth:web,sanctum' + operator role) so wiring this up later requires no backend route change, only a syncService.ts addition.
